description: Middle Iron Age to Roman settlement. During a Late Iron Age phase of construction a sub-rectangular enclosure with another sub-rectangular enclosure at its centre was constructed, this is interpreted as a shrine, presumably on morphological grounds. It appears to have gone out of use in the early 2nd CE.
